_comment: The writer's per-account token buckets for client routes: `burst` requests at once, then one more every `refillMs`. Every client route has one (`status` is the GET /arma/status read that carries a token). Loaded by server/writer/writer.js (DEFAULT_LIMITS); the numbers are explained in docs/MULTIPLAYER-DATA-LAYER.md. `maintenance` is the writer's own timers.
